headword: {床下浸水|ゆかしたしんすい}
gloss: below-floor flooding; flooding that reaches under the floor but not into the living space

definitions.gloss: below-floor flooding; flooding under the floor
definitions.explanation: A classification used in Japanese disaster reporting for flooding in which water enters the space beneath a house's floor but does not rise above the floor level into the living space. This is the less severe of the two standard damage categories, the other being {床上浸水|ゆかうえしんすい}.

examples.japanese: {床下浸水|ゆかしたしんすい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{被害|ひがい}→被害：02572_higai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}た→出る：00513_deru⟧。
⟦{台風|たいふう}→台風：01455_taifuu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{市内|しない}→市内：20934_shinai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{数十|すうじゅう}→数十：21400_suujuu⟧{軒|けん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{床下浸水|ゆかしたしんすい}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Due to the typhoon, dozens of houses in the city experienced below-floor flooding.

examples.japanese: ⟦{大雨|おおあめ}→大雨：03015_ooame⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{影響|えいきょう}→影響：01877_eikyou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{床下浸水|ゆかしたしんすい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{五十|ごじゅう}→五十：00930_gojuu⟧{軒|けん}、⟦{床上浸水|ゆかうえしんすい}→床上浸水：23615_yukaueshinsui⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{十|じゅう}→十：00708_juu⟧{軒|けん}⟦{報告|ほうこく}→報告：03618_houkoku⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: As a result of the heavy rain, fifty houses have been reported with below-floor flooding and ten with above-floor flooding.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{床下|ゆかした}→床下：24969_yukashita⟧ ("under the floor") + ⟦{浸水|しんすい}→浸水：14945_shinsui⟧ ("flooding, inundation"). A standard category used by Japanese municipalities, fire departments, and news media when tallying damage from heavy rain or typhoons. Because traditional Japanese homes are built on raised foundations with a crawl space beneath the floor, water can enter that crawl space without reaching the living area; such cases are classified as {床下浸水|ゆかしたしんすい}.

USAGE:
- Always appears as a fixed compound; it is not productive as a general verb phrase.
- Typically used as a suru-verb or a simple noun: {床下浸水|ゆかしたしんすい}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧, {床下浸水|ゆかしたしんすい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{被害|ひがい}→被害：02572_higai⟧.
- Contrasted with ⟦{床上浸水|ゆかうえしんすい}→床上浸水：23615_yukaueshinsui⟧, which is treated as more serious because water enters the living space and damages tatami, flooring, and furniture.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {床下浸水|ゆかしたしんすい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{被害|ひがい}→被害：02572_higai⟧: damage from below-floor flooding
- {床下浸水|ゆかしたしんすい}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to be flooded below floor level
- {床下浸水|ゆかしたしんすい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{発生|はっせい}する→発生する：25529_hasseisuru⟧: below-floor flooding occurs
- {床下浸水|ゆかしたしんすい}○○{軒|けん}: XX houses with below-floor flooding

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{床上浸水|ゆかうえしんすい}→床上浸水：23615_yukaueshinsui⟧: above-floor flooding — water enters the living space; considered more severe and often triggers disaster assistance

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{浸水|しんすい}→浸水：14945_shinsui⟧: flooding, inundation (the general term)
- ⟦{冠水|かんすい}→冠水：20916_kansui⟧: submersion (typically of roads or fields)
- ⟦{水害|すいがい}→水害：13261_suigai⟧: flood damage (broad term)
- ⟦{被害|ひがい}→被害：02572_higai⟧: damage
